summary: Extends IS-IS Traffic Engineering (RFC 5305) to distribute network-performance information, such as latency, in a scalable way. This matters in networks like financial data networks where such measures matter as much as other metrics for path selection. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Sometimes the fastest road matters more than the shortest. This lets routers share how quick each link is, such as how long messages take, so they can pick well.
